title: West Wodonga Junior Sport Registration Day
description: Clubs set up under one roof so families can sign up for the season in one trip. Football, netball, cricket and soccer. Bring Medicare details.

title: Lavington Car Boot Sale
description: Boot sale in the community hall car park. Sellers pay a small site fee, buyers get in free. Tools, plants, kids gear and household clearouts.
price: $10 per selling site, free for buyers

title: Culcairn Trivia Night
description: Tables of six, licensed bar, raffle at half time. Proceeds go back to the hall. Book a table or turn up and join one on the night.

title: Thurgoona Community Garden Working Bee
description: Weeding, mulching and bed prep at the community garden. Bring gloves and a hat. Tools provided. Morning tea afterwards. No experience needed.

title: Albury Farmers Market
description: Growers from the Riverina and north east Victoria set up in QEII Square. Fruit, veg, eggs, bread and coffee. Bring a bag and come early.

title: Beechworth Seed Swap
description: Bring saved seed or seedlings and trade for something new. Advice on what grows at altitude. Free. Spare jars and envelopes on the table.

title: Jindera Men's Shed Open Day
description: Doors open at the shed for anyone curious about joining. Look through the workshop, talk to members, have a sausage. Open to all ages.

title: Baranduda Community Garden Working Bee
description: Bed turning, composting and a bit of fence repair. Tools and gloves supplied. Two hours of work, then a cuppa. Kids welcome with a parent.

title: Yackandandah Repair Cafe
description: Small appliances, bikes, clothing and furniture. Volunteers work with you, not for you, so you learn the fix. Free, donations welcome.

title: Myrtleford Come and Try Night
description: Have a go at the local club sports with no commitment. Gear provided. Suits kids and adults. Turn up in runners and something you can move in.

title: Corowa Produce Market
description: Local produce, preserves and plants in the memorial hall. Cash is handy, though most stalls take cards now. Runs rain or shine.

title: Chiltern Craft Fair
description: Handmade goods in the memorial hall. Cards, woodwork, jams and knitting. Gold coin entry. Tea and scones served all day in the supper room.

title: Holbrook Swap Meet
description: Car and machinery parts, tools and memorabilia at the showground. Sellers pay per site. Gates open early for stallholders.

title: Wagga Wagga Business Networking Breakfast
description: Early start, short talk, then open networking. Bring cards. Aimed at small operators and sole traders across the Riverina. Booking required.

title: Rutherglen Produce Market
description: Olives, cheese, bread and seasonal fruit from growers between Rutherglen and Corowa. Free entry. Cash and card both work on most stalls.

title: Tallangatta Bowls Club Open Day
description: Free roll up on the greens with coaching for anyone new. Bowls and flat shoes available to borrow. Afternoon tea included.

title: Henty Craft Fair
description: Quilting, knitting, woodwork and preserves under one roof. Small entry fee. Devonshire tea in the supper room from ten in the morning.

title: Wangaratta Swap Meet
description: Parts, tools, signage and project cars at the showgrounds. Sellers book a site, buyers pay at the gate. Food van on site from seven.

title: Howlong Repair Cafe
description: Bring a broken lamp, toaster, chair or jumper. Volunteers help you fix it rather than bin it. Free to attend, donations go to the hall.

title: Tocumwal Model Railway Open Day
description: Layouts running all day, from HO scale to garden gauge. Kids can drive a train. Small entry fee and under twelves get in free.

title: Wodonga Twilight Market
description: Stalls, food vans and live music from late afternoon into the evening. Bring a chair. Parking on the grass. Free entry.

title: Shepparton Business Networking Breakfast
description: Breakfast, one short speaker, then open floor. Goulburn Valley operators, mostly small business. Booking required and you pay on the door.

title: Lockhart Bowls Club Open Day
description: Barefoot bowls, coaching and a free roll up for newcomers. Bowls provided. Flat shoes only. Bar and canteen open through the afternoon.

title: Bright Twilight Market
description: Late afternoon stalls in the park by the Ovens River. Food, produce and makers. Free entry. Busy in December, so walk in if you can.
